/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/arklib-v4.31.0/ArkLib/ProofSystem/Binius/BinaryBasefold/Prelude.lean').read_text()
start=src.index('theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly\\n')
end=src.index(' := by\\n  simp only\\n',start)
statement=src[start:end]
proof=''' := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ ℓ := i.isLt
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have h_fiber : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i hi y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i hi y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 hi
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hsplit (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 1).val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 0).val) =
      P_i_plus_1.eval y.val
  rw [hsplit, hsplit]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [h_fiber]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul,
        Fin.eta, mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
'''
Path('candidate.lean').write_text(statement+proof)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
